result.title: Decouple to Reuse: Fine-Grained Knowledge Augmentation for Time Series Foundation Models
result.summary: Time series forecasting is critical for demand prediction and resource management in modern Web services, yet applying pretrained Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) to downstream tasks remains challenging due to domain shifts. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically retrieve coarse-grained window contexts and may introduce context-specific noise. To address this problem, we argue that temporal patterns should be reused at a decomposition level, as effective trend and seasonal dynamics may originate from different contexts. We propose \method, a two-stage \underline{F}ine-grained \underline{K}nowledge \underline{A}ugmentation framework that decouples and consolidates pre-training knowledge into compact, task-shared residual codebooks to enhance frozen TSFMs. Specifically, Stage I constructs dual-branch residual codebooks for decoupled trend and seasonal signals, while Stage II dynamically retrieves and merges these fine-grained patterns into target representations via task-adaptive aggregation and gate fusion. Extensive experiments across eight real-world benchmarks with four representative TSFM backbones demonstrate the superior effectiveness and computational efficiency of \method, while further validating the strong transferability of the residual codebooks across different backbones. The source code is available at the anonymous repository: https://github.com/yuppielqx/TSFM-Component-Token-Adapter

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对时间序列基础模型的域偏移问题，提出两阶段细粒度知识增强框架：先用双分支残差码本分别解耦趋势与季节模式，再以任务自适应聚合和门控融合将检索到的细粒度模式动态注入冻结的模型表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「解耦检索＋门控融合注入冻结骨干」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的细粒度筛选与写入内部状态的机制提供核查线索，但领域相距较远，需确认门控是否真正按样本选择性使用检索内容。
